text:
laney: Quick idea — Snack Swap & Game Jam this Thursday in the big kitchen? 5pm start, short sign-up so we don't end up with 12 bags of chips :grin:
omar: Love it. 5pm works. I'll bring a pack of cigars — jk 😂 I mean pretzels. Any dietary notes?
jo: Count me in. I'll bring a small table-top game (Wingspan minis). Also can we do a 10-min 'snack show-and-tell' so folks can explain homemade stuff?
sanjay: 5pm is good. I'm allergic to tree nuts — can we mark that on the sign-up? Also can someone grab plates/napkins?
morgan: I'll handle plates/napkins + cups. Happy to bring hummus and pita. Also can someone bring a bluetooth speaker?
laney: amazing — thanks @morgan. I'll make a tiny signup form: https://tinyurl.com/rw-snacks (please add what you plan to bring + dietary tags)
laney: Proposed mini-agenda:
``` 
5:00-5:10 quick intros + snack show-and-tell
5:10-6:20 games rotational tables
6:20-6:30 group photo + clean up
```
omar: +1 agenda
jo: Could we add a 'quiet corner' for folks who want to work while nibbling? Some prefer low noise.
laney: good call — will add that to the form
calendar-bot: Event created: Snack Swap & Game Jam — Thu 17:00 in Big Kitchen. RSVP count: 3
sanjay: I'll bring an extension cord and power strip for any boardgame timers/devices
morgan: Also bringing a small ukulele for jam if anyone wants to sing :guitar:
omar: If we get rained on (if the roof is booked) plan B = 7th floor lounge? tagging @facilities
laney: tagging @facilities — can you reserve 7th floor lounge as backup? :pray:
facilities: (via bot) 7th floor lounge tentatively reserved for Thu 17:00-19:00. Confirm by Wed noon.
jo: RSVP'd on the form. I put 'Wingspan + snacks (gluten free)'
omar: RSVP'd — pretzels
sanjay: RSVP'd — bringing nut-free cookies
laney: Thanks everyone! Will post final reminder Wed 10am. :calendar:
